regions.explanation: From 21.92s to 23.48s (“For I have sworn before”), pitch range (10th–90th percentile) narrowed to 0.7 st from 4.8 st (-86%); that is 4.5× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Pitch movement is the main cue English listeners use to find the focus word of a phrase; with a flattened contour every word carries equal weight and the line sounds recited. Fix: Lift pitch on the focus word of each clause and let it fall at the end of the thought.
